root_cause: GitHub Actions infrastructure experienced a Service Unavailable condition that prevented jobs from resolving and downloading required action repositories during the 'Set up job' phase. Multiple retries were attempted (retrying in ~22 seconds, ~47 seconds) before failing with HTTP 503. This is a transient GitHub Actions platform outage unrelated to the PR changes (which only touch RISC-V64 fill emitter files). The C++ unit tests job also hit a timeout/cancellation that appears secondary to the infrastructure issues delaying the overall pipeline.
reproduction_steps: N/A - GitHub Actions platform outage, not reproducible locally.
recommended_actions: Re-add PR #37189 to the merge queue - the failure is transient and unrelated to the PR changes.
Monitor GitHub Actions status page (githubstatus.com) for ongoing service disruptions.
If failures persist after re-queuing, check for any regression in action version pinning.
prevention_strategies: No prevention possible for GitHub platform outages. Consider adding retry logic in workflows for action download failures.
historical_context: This is the second occurrence of this exact Infrastructure pattern (signature 20483f6ec6095dbe) for this same PR. First occurrence was at 2026-08-06T15:27:25Z in run 31112143407.
